firm_data.firm_description: Leason Ellis is a full-service intellectual property law firm with a deep bench of professionals and a collaborative, hands-on approach. They focus on patent, copyright, trademark, and litigation.
notable_facts: Yuval H. Marcus was appointed as Managing Partner effective January 1st, succeeding David Leason who served since the firm's founding in 2008.
In 2023, the firm celebrated its 15th anniversary.
Lauren Emerson and Jordan Garner have been appointed to the Executive Committee of the Firm.

ai_contact.ai_notes: The Newtonian Issue #39, Winter 2026, is the AI Issue: Artificial Intelligence is Reshaping IP Law
